long_description:
From passing a prereq to landing your dream job, Wyzant connects people who need to know with the experts who can teach them.

Book your 1-to-1 lesson with an expert today and start moving forward.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Partner at YC for quite a while. Wrote a lot of essays, funded great companies. Built the Series A program.

Now working on Magid and Co to help founders minimize fundraising burden while maximizing valuations / leverage. I love that I get to keep working with YC companies.

founders.title: Founder/Product & Engineering
founders.founder_bio:
Hey 👋 I'm Ryan — a General Partner at Orange Collective, a YC alumni fund backing the next generation of YC founders. 

Along my startup journey, I became an SEO expert and have used it to help grow companies like Calm, Zapier, Rippling, and Shutterstock.

Previously I was the CEO of RankScience (W17), Co-founder of Tutorspree (W11), and was the first employee at SeatGeek (valued at $1B+).
